Featured

Founder Frederick Yates Jr., a proud South Carolina native and military veteran, built Yates Boxing & Fitness LLC on the values of discipline, structure, and resilience.

As a veteran who understands the mental battles that can come with depression and PTSD, Frederick believes boxing is more than a physical outlet — it’s a tool for mental clarity, emotional control, and personal stability.

Boxing provides routine, focus, and purpose. It teaches individuals how to manage stress, channel emotions in a healthy way, and rebuild confidence through consistent effort and discipline.

This gym exists to support youth and adults — especially those fighting battles you can’t always see — by giving them a structured environment to grow mentally and physically.

This is more than training. This is healing through discipline.
